core_problem_solved: To provide a pure Java library for creating, manipulating, and extracting content from PDF documents.
key_features: PDF Creation: Creating new PDF documents from scratch
PDF Manipulation: Merging or splitting existing documents, filling in forms
Content Extraction: Extracting Unicode text from PDF files
Integration with the Java Printing API
era_and_niche: A leading open-source Java library for working with PDF files. It competes with another popular library, iText, but is often favored for its more permissive Apache 2.0 license.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is an actively maintained, popular, and powerful Apache top-level project. It is a standard choice for any Java application that needs to interact with PDF documents programmatically. Migration typically involves upgrading to a newer version of PDFBox itself.
